instruction_for_grok: Load this pattern before re-analyzing the IMK rule change or AfD Sachsen-Anhalt 2026. Do not reopen the settled facts below. Separate measurement, reported claim, and author inference. Do not treat the ESG-Carbon telemetry number as a score for this political case.
case: IMK drops unwritten unanimity for a 13-of-16 threshold after the Saxony-Anhalt election

settled_reported_facts.election: Landtag Sachsen-Anhalt, 6 September 2026. AfD 43.8 percent, 39 of 83 seats, three short of a majority. CDU 17.2 percent. Ulrich Siegmund said he wants to be elected minister-president before Christmas. December IMK still represented by caretaker Tamara Zieschang (CDU).
settled_reported_facts.old_rule: Unwritten unanimity: a decision only if no Land actively objected. Abstentions allowed. Reservations could be recorded in a protocol note without a no vote.
settled_reported_facts.new_rule: Written circulation procedure. A decision stands with at least 13 of 16 Land votes. Up to three Länder can dissent without blocking.
settled_reported_facts.stated_motive: Prevent a blockade by a possible AfD interior minister from Saxony-Anhalt. Daniela Behrens (SPD) had already said at the autumn 2025 conference that the IMK should remain able to decide.
settled_reported_facts.side_channel: Joachim Herrmann (CSU), speaker of the B-Länder, said CDU/CSU will not cooperate with the AfD. An AfD minister could attend the plenary, not the A/B pre-meetings.
settled_reported_facts.legal_weight: IMK decisions coordinate the Länder. They are not statutes.

pattern.name: preemptive veto removal
pattern.sehen: An actor is about to occupy a seat that, under the current rule, is a veto.
pattern.sagen: Incumbents reframe the rule as capacity to decide, and name the anticipated actor as the blockage.
pattern.suehnen: Raise the dissent cost before the actor sits. Here from 1 no-vote to 4 (13/16). Add an informal exclusion (no A/B caucus).
repeat_signature: rule change timed before the new seat is filled
written or accelerated procedure rather than an open session with the new actor
public justification is blockade prevention, not a general efficiency review
formal threshold stays high, so the change looks like continuity
real exclusion moves to a side channel the new actor cannot enter

not_this: Do not score this case with esg_carbon 0.940649363402773. That figure is soil/governance telemetry from rosary-atlas/gov_telemetry.json.
Do not treat TRL 9 or bankable ESG asset class as evidence about the IMK.
Do not claim the AfD already holds the interior ministry. As of 2 October 2026 it does not.
reuse: Apply sehen/sagen/suehnen plus the five repeat signatures to the next format. Keep each new case in its own file under memory/patterns/.
